newsitem.title: UK: Britain's highest-paid man pockets huge pay rise.
newsitem.headline: Britain's highest-paid man pockets huge pay rise.

text.p: Britain's highest paid man, little-known investment manager Nicholas Roditi, has been awarded a pay rise of more than 500,000 pounds ($800,000) a week, a British newspaper said on Friday.

Roditi, who manages the 1.8 billion pound Quota investment fund for billionaire Hungarian tycoon George Soros, will collect 80 million pounds a year after the increase of nearly 30 million, the Evening Standard said.
The increase is his reward for betting the right way on the surging pound and dollar last year, it said.
Publicity-shy Roditi is reported to operate from a small office in a residential area of north London.

The issue of huge pay rises is particularly sensitive in Britain. The public has been outraged by the million-pound-plus salary increases awarded to City dealers and to so-called "fat cat" directors of privatised utilities.
